organization.name_ja: セイコーグループ株式会社

affected.note: About 60,000 personal data records held by Seiko Group, Seiko Watch and Seiko Instruments, per the third report of 2023-10-25. Includes Seiko Watch customers, business contacts, recruitment applicants and current and former employees. Credit card data was not included.

summary.en: Seiko Group detected unauthorized access to some of its servers on 2023-07-28 and later determined it was a ransomware attack. It confirmed that about 60,000 personal data records of customers, business contacts, job applicants and employees leaked.
summary.ja: セイコーグループは2023年7月28日に一部サーバーへの不正アクセスを検知し、その後ランサムウェア攻撃と判断した。顧客、取引先関係者、採用応募者、従業員などに関する約6万件の個人情報が漏えいしたことを確認したと公表した。
